scenario: Two combinations at one object/element station with different signs.
assertions: Both source stations survive conversion to mm.
N and Nmm become kN and kNm without changing signs.
Different rows, axes or analysis revisions have different identities.

scenario: 6 m simply supported beam: q=10 kN/m, E=25000 MPa, I=3125000000 mm4.
assertions: Each upward reaction is 30 kN; midpoint moment 45 kNm and downward deflection 2.16 mm.
Point loads retain both sides of the shear jump.
Continuous support hogging moments and settlements match independent formulas.

scenario: Two 20 mm bars at y=450 mm and one 16 mm bar at y=390 mm in a 500 mm-deep section.
assertions: Area is 829.38046055 mm2 and bottom-face effective depth 435.45454545 mm.
Top-face depth is measured from the opposite compression face.
Cover and spacing failures retain their bar identifiers.

scenario: Four 20 mm bars 6000 mm long; 300x500x6000 mm concrete; soffit plus two sides.
assertions: At 7850 kg/m3 steel mass is 59.18760559 kg; concrete 0.9 m3; formwork 7.8 m2.
A 90-degree bend on a 16 mm bar with 32 mm internal radius adds 62.83185307 mm to tangent lengths.
Omitted rates return no cost, never default prices.

scenario: Cheapest candidate omits SLS, second fails SLS, third passes all required checks.
assertions: Only the third candidate is feasible.
An incomplete domain cannot claim complete enumeration.
Required checks cannot be waived through notApplicable.

scenario: Sagging midspan, hogging support, neutral axis below flange and doubly reinforced alternatives.
assertions: Actual d and compression-steel depth come from selected bars.
Return required/provided steel, neutral axis/strain regime, moment resistance, minimum/maximum steel and governing row.
Flange contributes only on its applicable compression side.
Axial/biaxial actions need a covered interaction method before member completion.

scenario: Same support-adjacent demand under a concentrated load and a UDL.
assertions: Evaluate design shear stress, concrete contribution, maximum stress, required/provided links, minimum links and maximum spacing.
Enhancement applies only to its covered concentrated-load case.
Concurrent torsion routes through combined demand before selecting final links.

scenario: Nonzero T concurrent with V and M at a support station.
assertions: Use one concurrent action vector per interaction check.
Return equivalent shear/moments and transverse plus longitudinal demands.
Check closed links, corner/side bars, perimeter spacing and development, not only total longitudinal area.
Zero T still runs applicable ordinary shear/link rules.

scenario: Same geometry with different sustained load, age, humidity and finish-installation date.
assertions: Screening is identified separately from calculated deflection.
Service combinations never substitute factored ULS forces.
Report instantaneous, creep/shrinkage and incremental-after-finishes components and limits.
Method-specific creep, cracking and stiffness assumptions are returned.

scenario: Equal steel area with different bar spacing and cover.
assertions: Return steel stress/strain, effective tension region, cover/spacing terms, calculated width, limit and governing service row.
Different arrangements can give different crack widths despite equal steel area.

scenario: Straight, hooked and bent bar endings at an end support.
assertions: Development demand depends on stress state, grade/bar type and bond conditions.
Available length uses the correct reference face and explicit bend/hook credit convention.
Simple-support anchorage conditions are evaluated where applicable.

scenario: Support top bars curtailed toward midspan; bottom bars spliced outside a prohibited zone.
assertions: Check minimum extension past theoretical cutoff and anchorage at actual termination.
Check remaining bars and extra links at cutoffs where required.
Laps respect tension/compression rules, spliced percentage, staggering and zone restrictions.
Couplers are counted and carry qualification/installation references.

scenario: Beam ends with capacity-design shear, confinement zones and joint development.
assertions: Geometry-only IS13920 checks do not constitute complete seismic detailing.
Evaluate top/bottom continuity, proportions, hoops, hooks, zone lengths and splice placement.
Capacity-based shear can govern over imported elastic-analysis shear.
Dependent joint/system checks retain their engineering result references.

scenario: Change code dataset or a required-check profile.
assertions: Inputs and results carry new identities; prior results are marked as needing recalculation.
Normalized IS source distribution permission is already recorded in the repository.

scenario: Two continuous spans with support widths, offsets and T-section slab.
assertions: Store centreline, clear, effective design, flexible analysis and physical quantity lengths separately.
Support faces, point loads, section changes, reinforcement changes and extrema become check stations.

scenario: Selected multi-element frame with two ULS and two SLS combinations.
assertions: Check all CSI return codes and equal result-array lengths.
Acquire units, local axes, sections/materials/modifiers/releases/offsets, analysis state and all raw rows.
No blanket component maxima create fictional simultaneous actions.
Normalization is implemented; COM acquisition is the next adapter operation.

scenario: Ordinary continuous beam with top/bottom regions, torsion and service cases.
assertions: Iterate bar arrangement and actual depth before final checks.
Aggregate all applicable ULS, SLS, detailing and construction results without a partial pass.
Retain governing row/station/face and requirement IDs for every result.

scenario: Multi-layer mixed bars, end hooks, laps and varying link spacing.
assertions: Each mark has tangent straights, bend centreline arcs, start/end stations and count.
Bar intersections/layer enclosure and congestion use actual geometry.
No full-span-bar assumption is substituted for a curtailed or lapped path.

scenario: Same schedule exported to workbook and shop schedule.
assertions: Marks/shape dimensions/counts/cut lengths/mass reconcile to the same detail identity.
Stock cutting, laps, waste and offcuts are distinct; no waste double counting.
Link count uses first/last positions and zone-end inclusion conventions.

scenario: Compare isolated rectangular beam and beam monolithic with slab.
assertions: Concrete uses explicit net segments and overlap/deduction policy.
Soffit, exposed sides, end bulkheads and slab/support interfaces are itemized.
Actual links, anchorage, laps and side bars contribute to steel.
Direct cost foundation is callable; labour/overhead/tax/waste model extends it explicitly.

scenario: Partial candidate search then changed-depth coupled candidate.
assertions: All required ULS/SLS/detailing checks precede ranking.
Best among evaluated candidates is distinct from a proven optimum of a fully enumerated domain.
Changes to stiffness, section, releases, offsets, self weight or loads require fresh analysis for coupled results.
Fixed-action comparisons explicitly retain their common force assumption.

scenario: Change one beam property on a copy and reacquire the same selections.
assertions: Verify target copy/model/property identity before writes.
Record every changed property, CSI return code, saved copy and new analysis identity.
Reimport and recheck resulting forces before comparison or report.
No live model operation is executed by this foundation setup.

scenario: Blank cell, pasted invalid row, manual mode, save/reopen and missing add-in.
assertions: Use separate project/member/sections/actions/reinforcement/checks/BBS/quantities sheets with stable table columns.
Blank, zero, omitted and invalid text remain distinct.
Changed inputs invalidate associated results immediately.
Pure UDFs calculate; commands perform import, optimization, save and export.
Rows report exact cell/field/action identity and actionable input errors.

scenario: Report with governing checks, section/elevation, BBS and quantities.
assertions: Include input assumptions, code/rule references, formulas/normalized substitutions, required/provided values, utilization and governing cases.
Retain project/member/revision/engine/dataset and input/result hashes.
Prepared/checked/approved fields refer to real people and recorded actions; do not invent professional signatures.
Exports use one current complete member result and resolved schedule.

scenario: Scalar UDF, 1000-beam batch, force-table import and cancellable candidate search.
assertions: Record cold start, warm median/p95, allocations, memory, Excel bitness/build/runtime and machine.
Separate calculation from COM transfer, rendering and workbook save.
Use bulk reads/writes and avoid volatile per-cell ETABS calls.
Initial UX targets: typical recalculation under 1 s and responsive cancellation/progress within 250 ms; validate on a named reference machine before claiming them.

scenario: Mixed diameters and three layers with side bars, rounded link corners and a joint congestion zone.
assertions: Check pairwise horizontal/vertical clearance, aggregate passage, cover to the correct steel surface and link-bend enclosure.
Compute each tension/compression group centroid separately; never mix top and bottom groups into one effective depth.
Construction fit includes insertion/placement sequence and joint clashes where selected.
The current geometry helper evaluates one tension group inside a clear rectangle; full-member fit extends this.
